svg.title: Logger — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as logger, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A compact chainsaw has a long rounded bar and two separately visible raised handles. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
